# ACTOTIVE RAIL TRADE

> ACTOTIVE supplies locomotive, rolling stock, passenger-car, turbocharger and marine-engine components, together with technical support, global logistics and freight-forwarding services.

## Core capabilities

- Locomotive spare parts for EMD, GE, ALCO and Alstom diesel-engine applications.
- Turbocharger components that support locomotive performance and fuel efficiency.
- Passenger-car and marine-engine components.
- Component sourcing, technical consultation, quality assurance, supply-chain management and freight forwarding.

## Service regions

Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia.

## Quality and authorization

ACTOTIVE holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certifications. It is DB2 authorized for freight railway operations by the Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Transport and Infrastructure, valid through 13 May 2031.
